findings.title: Retained-memory bound omits per-root frontier storage
evidence: decomp/matching-notes/other-cpus/arm7-reachable-rust-design/README.md:183 claims O(N + E + RN) retained memory
source.patch reproduces lib/src/analysis/arm7_reachable.rs:178-179 with the same bound
lib/src/analysis/arm7_reachable.rs:279 constructs one traversal per root; line 310 reserves E + 1 frontier slots in each traversal
lib/src/analysis/arm7_reachable.rs:331 stores every reachable frontier edge per root
findings.impact: For R roots and E original transfers, the constructor retains O(R*E) frontier capacity in addition to O(R*N) predecessors. A caller with many roots and dense transfers may allocate much more memory than the published bound predicts.
findings.suggested_resolution: Either size frontier vectors on demand and state an O(N + E + R*(N + E)) worst-case retained bound, or change the representation to satisfy the stated O(N + E + R*N) bound. Update both design README and source API comment consistently.
